$comment: Limits the report guardrails enforce. The AI service applies all of them; the API applies those marked in contracts/README.md again, independently. Authoritative: edit here, then run `npm run contracts`.
unestablishedCauseNote: Hypothesis "{title}" limited to {cap} and rated possible: the outcome is DEGRADED, so the cause is not established.
unverifiedCauseNote: Hypothesis "{title}" limited to {cap} and rated possible: the report carries no assessment of the evidence, so no cause is verified.
unverifiedOutcomeNote: The report states the outcome {claimed}, but it carries no assessment of the evidence, so that outcome is not verified and is not recorded.

withdrawalReasons.unlikelyHypothesis: it would change production on the strength of a hypothesis rated unlikely
withdrawalReasons.noIncident: it would change production, and the evidence supports {outcome}, not an incident with an established cause
withdrawalReasons.noAssessment: it would change production, and the report carries no assessment of the evidence, so no incident with an established cause is verified

nextStepPrefixes.highRisk: Higher-risk alternative, only if the lower-risk action is not possible: {title}. {description}
